validation.notes: Ran from the workspace root on Node 24.14.0; exit code 0 with 'resource-consistency regression: passed (project-trust, settings-manager, resource-loader)'. The script imports only node:assert/strict plus the read-only .prale-eval/subject.mjs helper, which links the real submitted project-trust.ts, settings-manager.ts and resource-loader.ts (SettingsManager parsing/trust/merge code, DefaultResourceLoader.reload and resolveProjectTrusted all execute live; only storage, package-manager, extension-loader and UI boundaries are in-memory fakes). Assertions cover the producer/consumer chain: (1) project-trust - a stored false is authoritative over defaultProjectTrust=always and is not re-prompted or overwritten, a stored true beats 'never', only null/undefined falls through to the policy, trustOverride still wins, the 'ask' path persists the picked option and denies without UI, and an extension project_trust decision is awaited (promise-gated, ordering asserted) before any fallback and is remembered when requested; (2) settings-manager - project values override global at top level (defaultModel) and nested level (compaction.reserveTokens) while the non-overridden nested global default (compaction.keepRecentTokens=2000) survives, arrays are replaced rather than concatenated, untrusted state empties project settings and restores global values across reload(), re-trusting reloads the project file, and applyOverrides sits on top until a reload; (3) resource-loader - an approved decision reaches settings reload and final resource assembly (resolve events [resolve,false,global-model] bootstrap then [resolve,true,project-model], extension set cli.ts/global.ts/project.ts, merged project settings visible), a remembered denial under 'always' keeps isProjectTrusted()=false and withholds project.ts, and an extension-reported denial is stored via trustStore and honoured on later reloads. Mutation check performed manually: restoring each of the three source files alone to the fixture baseline (git checkout of that one path, others left repaired) makes the same script exit 1 with a distinct assertion failure - 'a stored denial must not fall through to defaultProjectTrust=always' (project-trust), 'project settings must override global settings' (settings-manager), 'an approved decision must be applied' (resource-loader); no crash, import error or timeout. Asynchronous ordering is driven by explicit promises (deferred extension hook), no wall-clock time, randomness or network is used. Temporary fixture inputs are written to .prale-eval/.tmp-regression-fixtures and removed in a finally block (asserted gone); nothing outside the workspace is touched. Limitation: the repository's own vitest suites (packages/coding-agent/test/**) could not be used as extra evidence because no node_modules are installed and dependencies must not be installed in this environment; the module graphs therefore run under node:module stripTypeScriptTypes, which emits only 'ExperimentalWarning' messages (harmless).
